title: kbmon querylog panel: spool waiting, undelivered entries, last delivery outcome, usage and cost today
goal: the querylog panel of kbmon.py shows the spool's waiting rows by kind, the local store's entries not yet delivered, the last distill and apply outcome and today's usage rows with their tokens and cost in USD, read through the query log's own readers; it prints no question, prompt or reply text of the query log

clauses.clause: the querylog panel of kbmon.py shows the spool's waiting rows by kind, the local store's entries not yet delivered, the last distill and apply outcome and today's usage rows with their tokens and cost in USD, read through the query log's own readers
it prints no question, prompt or reply text of the query log

gates.question: Does the querylog panel get its counts from new structured readers beside the text ones in ql_report.py, or from the lines the existing readers print?
options: new structured readers in ql_report.py beside the text ones
parse the lines querylog.py show and status print
gates.recommendation: new structured readers in ql_report.py beside the text ones
gates.answer: new structured readers in ql_report.py beside the text ones

gates.question: Which entries does the querylog panel count as not yet delivered?
options: run files of the local store that origin/main lacks (0 in mode local)
spool rows whose entry the local store holds
gates.recommendation: run files of the local store that origin/main lacks (0 in mode local)
gates.answer: run files of the local store that origin/main lacks (0 in mode local)

gates.question: Which rows make the panel's usage of today?
options: the day's usage rows of the spool plus the local store's usage sidecars of the day's runs, once per prompt
the day's usage rows of the spool only
gates.recommendation: the day's usage rows of the spool plus the local store's usage sidecars of the day's runs, once per prompt
gates.answer: the day's usage rows of the spool plus the local store's usage sidecars of the day's runs, once per prompt

gates.question: What time does the panel give for the last distill and apply outcome?
options: the distill.log's last write, on the outcome that stands last in the log only
gates.recommendation: the distill.log's last write, on the outcome that stands last in the log only
gates.answer: the distill.log's last write, on the outcome that stands last in the log only

notes: Plan 2026-10-18: a planted query log home needs CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT (the clone) together (ql_base.plugin_data); with DATA alone capture writes to the clone's real spool, which a planning probe did and the planner removed. Data: spool {files, rows, by_kind}, undelivered, last_delivery {outcome, why, when} or null, usage_today {rows, tokens, usd}. Cost is priced as backlog.py cost prices it (bench_core.PRICE). Layout of the querylog panel (operator's spec): spool (rows in files · rows per kind) · delivery (undelivered count · last pushed commit and time) · today (rows · tokens · cost); a refused delivery is a `!!` row (`!!delivery  REFUSED gate … · since … · undelivered N`), a fetch failure a `! ` row. Planner 2026-10-18: check 1 (no prompt text in --json or --once) passes before the work by design: today kbmon has no querylog panel to leak text through; it pins the no-prompt-text rule the panel must keep, and check 0 fails until the panel exists.
